Name: Endeering
Author: EspurrQueen
Description:
Want more types of spotted deer? Big fan of the deer species [i]dama dama [/i](Fallow Deer)? Now you can add these majestic beasts to your barns and deer herds!

This mod adds 6 different alt skins

You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45939]Mizu's Deer[/url] in order to use this mod, of course, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] (Content Patcher ver coming soon!).
